mapper.select: SELECT (case when #{continue_flag} = 'N' then '' else t1.tab_type end) tab_type, t1.tab_code, t1.tab_group, t1.tab_seq FROM () t1 WHERE t1.layout_code = #{layout_code} AND ( t1.tree_code = #{tree_code} OR #{tree_code} IS NULL ) AND ( ( t1.parent_tab_code IS NULL AND #{tab_tab_code} IS NULL ) OR ( #{tab_tab_code} IS NOT NULL AND t1.parent_tab_code = #{tab_tab_code} ) ) AND t1.enabled_flag = 'Y' GROUP BY t1.tab_type, t1.tab_code, t1.tab_group, t1.tab_seq ORDER BY t1.tab_seq, t1.tab_type

SELECT function_code, layout_code, tab_code, button_code, prompt, save_data_first, system_flag, display_flag, display_order, javascript, enabled_flag, created_by, creation_date, last_updated_by, last_update_date, icon, query_display_flag FROM hls_doc_layout_tab_button t1
${leaf_default_where_sql}
and t1.function_code=#{function_code} and t1.layout_code=#{layout_code} and t1.tab_code=#{tab_code} and t1.enabled_flag='Y' and t1.display_flag='Y'
order by t1.display_order

SELECT d.column_name, d.grid_order_seq, nvl(d.grid_order_type, 'ASCENDING') grid_order_type, d.data_type FROM hls_doc_layout_config d WHERE d.layout_code = #{layout_code} AND d.tab_code = #{tab_code} AND d.grid_order_seq IS NOT NULL AND d.enabled_flag = 'Y' ORDER BY d.grid_order_seq

SELECT config_id,layout_code FROM hls_doc_layout_config WHERE validation_type = 'LOV_D'
and layout_code = #{layoutCode}
